store_audited.eventTitle: E-Commerce Store or UCP Manifest Audited
store_audited.eventDescription: Charged per public merchant domain or inline UCP manifest bundle audited across /.well-known/ucp, /.well-known/agent.json, /llms.txt, Schema.org Offer parity, and all 10 Universal Commerce Protocol + AP2 payment mandate gates ($2.00 per 1,000 stores). Unreachable network errors, SSRF-blocked hosts, and malformed parse errors are not charged.
